amendments.reason: Pre-commit sequential testing showed that an opposite curve immediately after one active retention frame inherits up to the registered0.06 prior steering-state difference even though no new gain is applied. Require exactness from matched state and bounded same-sign carryover sequentially; current-obstacle reacquisition and latch clearing must disable new gain and converge.

Final independent audit showed that an abrupt opposite/straight fifth clearing frame or immediate opposing obstacle after active retention can also carry the prior bounded steering difference for one frame. Remove the incorrect universal exactness requirement, require no new gain plus same-sign carryover at most0.06, and add abrupt clearing, immediate obstacle, preview-marker and exact reversal-boundary transition coverage.

Final re-audit found that the broad first abort sentence still contradicted the explicitly accepted immediate-release carryover. Exempt only that registered bounded sequential transition while retaining the matched-state and all other exactness requirements.
